test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven friends are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Raj is second to the left of Sachin. Dinu is between Krip and Veer. Dinu is second to the right of Sachin. Raj is fourth to the right of Veer. Rocky is second to the right of Sam. Who is second to the left of Veer?
solution:
Seven friends are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Raj is second to the left of Sachin and Dinu is second to the right of Sachin.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8563348f98cb5f873db5380f043a31e7b8c3bcd67c82f624ef7ae73b052b0264.png] 

2) Raj is fourth to the right of Veer and Dinu is between Krip and Veer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d15ffe35ba8be6170e6683313e4c12292b565db337839e48084bdf240a4fc5de.png] 

3) Rocky is second to the right of Sam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e681ef5076ff8ad1ae295a35333cc96c2498f15f7fc20639b09eb373d177382.png] 

∴ Here, 'Rocky' is second to the left of Veer.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Rocky".**
